description.en: X-mount lenses weighing under 200 grams — some lighter than a phone. Built for compact travel kits, daily carry, and small gimbals where keeping total weight down matters most.
description.zh: 重量低于 200 克的 X 卡口镜头，有些比手机还轻。适合轻装旅行、日常挂机或上小型稳定器，能把机身负重压到最低。

shortDescription.en: Under 200 grams for light travel and daily carry
shortDescription.zh: 重量低于 200 克，适合轻装出行

description.en: X-mount primes measuring 35mm or less in barrel length. From classic flat pancakes to compact wide and standard optics, they keep the camera small enough for a coat pocket and discreet on the street — the shortest barely protrude past a body cap.
description.zh: 镜身长度不超过 35mm 的 X 卡口定焦镜头。包含超薄饼干头、小广角和微型标头，装在机身上体积紧凑，放进外套口袋或街头抓拍都不显眼，最薄的几支几乎只比机身盖厚一点。

shortDescription.en: Barrel length 35mm or less for pocketable setups
shortDescription.zh: 镜身长度 35mm 以内，挂机紧凑

description.en: X-mount primes with a maximum aperture of F1.4 or wider, from practical F1.4 autofocus workhorses to F0.95 manual glass. Larger apertures gather more light for dim scenes and produce shallower depth of field for background separation.
description.zh: 最大光圈达到 F1.4 或更大的 X 卡口定焦镜头，涵盖实用的 F1.4 自动头到 F0.95 手动头。更大的进光量适合暗光拍摄，也能带来更浅的景深和背景虚化。

shortDescription.en: F1.4 and wider for low light and shallow depth of field
shortDescription.zh: 最大光圈 F1.4 或更大，适合暗光与虚化

description.en: Zooms that hold the same maximum aperture from the wide end to the tele end. Exposure and depth of field do not shift as you zoom, which simplifies manual exposure and keeps video cuts consistent compared with variable-aperture kit zooms.
description.zh: 变焦全程最大光圈保持不变的镜头。推拉变焦时快门、ISO 和景深不会跟着跳变，手动曝光和拍视频都比浮动光圈套机头更省心。

shortDescription.en: Fixed maximum aperture across the zoom range
shortDescription.zh: 变焦全程光圈恒定

description.en: X-mount lenses priced under $200 USD — mostly manual character primes, compact street pancakes, and a growing group of budget autofocus primes. An inexpensive way to try an unfamiliar focal length before committing to higher-end glass.
description.zh: 参考价在千元以内的 X 卡口镜头，包括全手动定焦、紧凑饼干头，也有不少平价自动对焦定焦。花不多的预算就能试一个没用过的焦段。

shortDescription.en: Affordable primes under $200
shortDescription.zh: 千元以内也有不少可用镜头

description.en: Where the main value options on X-mount sit. Under $400 USD covers fast third-party autofocus primes, compact zooms, and entry Fujifilm glass — practical everyday lenses without flagship pricing.
description.zh: X 卡口性价比集中的价位段。两千元以内已经能选到副厂大光圈自动对焦定焦、轻量变焦和部分原厂入门型号，日常挂机够用。

shortDescription.en: Practical everyday lenses under $400
shortDescription.zh: 实用焦段集中的高性价比价位

description.en: Native autofocus primes from Chinese makers like Viltrox, 7Artisans, and TTArtisan. They range from light everyday primes to F1.2 flagships, with focus motors improving generation by generation and competitive pricing against first-party options.
description.zh: 唯卓仕、七工匠、铭匠等国产品牌推出的原生自动对焦定焦。从轻量日常定焦到 F1.2 旗舰都有覆盖，对焦马达和光学素质都在逐代追近原厂，价格更有优势。

shortDescription.en: From entry primes to F1.2 flagships
shortDescription.zh: 从入门定焦到 F1.2 旗舰

description.en: Manual-focus primes from Chinese makers like 7Artisans, TTArtisan, and Brightin Star that open to F1.2–F1.4. Mostly metal barrels with damped focus rings, offering real shallow depth of field and low-light headroom at a modest price if you don't mind manual focus.
description.zh: 七工匠、铭匠、星曜等国产品牌推出的 F1.2–F1.4 手动定焦。多为金属镜身，对焦阻尼适中，全开光圈能拿到明显的浅景深和暗光进光量，不介意手动对焦的话成本很低。

shortDescription.en: Fast F1.2–F1.4 manual primes
shortDescription.zh: F1.2–F1.4 的大光圈手动定焦

description.en: An F0.95 aperture used to belong mostly to expensive specialty lenses. Chinese makers like 7Artisans, TTArtisan, and Brightin Star brought it down to an accessible price, making razor-thin depth of field and extreme low-light gathering easy to try.
description.zh: F0.95 这种超大光圈过去多见于高价手动头。七工匠、铭匠、星曜等国产品牌把它拉到了亲民价位，花不多的钱就能体验极浅景深和暗光进光量。

shortDescription.en: F0.95 aperture within reach
shortDescription.zh: 平价体验 F0.95 超大光圈

description.en: Low-cost manual primes from makers like 7Artisans, TTArtisan, and Brightin Star across wide, standard, and portrait focal lengths. Mostly all-metal builds priced low enough to pick up a focal length or rendering style just to experiment.
description.zh: 七工匠、铭匠、星曜等国产品牌的平价手动定焦，焦段从广角到中长焦都有，多为全金属镜身。价格足够低，适合买来试试没拍过的焦段或成像风格。

shortDescription.en: Manual primes at an easy entry price
shortDescription.zh: 纯手动体验，入手门槛低

title.zh: 富士 XF 系列镜头

description.en: Fujifilm's main X-mount line. Most XF lenses include a physical aperture ring, faster focus motors, and weather sealing — the features XC leaves out — across focal lengths from F1.2 primes to super-telephotos.
description.zh: 富士 X 卡口的主力原厂系列。相比 XC，XF 普遍带有物理光圈环、更快的对焦马达，多数型号具备防滴防尘，焦段从 F1.2 大光圈定焦覆盖到超长焦。

shortDescription.en: Fujifilm's main line — aperture rings and weather sealing
shortDescription.zh: 原厂主力线，带光圈环与防滴防尘

title.zh: 富士 XC 系列镜头

description.en: Fujifilm's lightweight budget line, commonly bundled with camera bodies. XC drops the aperture ring and swaps metal barrels for composite plastic to cut weight and price, while keeping full autofocus and OIS on most models.
description.zh: 富士原厂的轻量入门线，常见于相机套机。XC 省去物理光圈环、改用复合材料镜身，重量和售价都更低，同时保留完整自动对焦，多数型号带 OIS 防抖。

shortDescription.en: Fujifilm's lightweight budget line, mostly kit zooms
shortDescription.zh: 原厂轻量入门线，以套机变焦为主

title.zh: 适马 Contemporary 系列镜头

description.en: Sigma's compact APS-C lineup, centered on a set of native F1.4 primes and compact F2.8 zooms. Built specifically for APS-C rather than adapted from full-frame designs, they keep size down without giving up sharpness.
description.zh: 适马针对 APS-C 画幅原生设计的产品线，核心是一组 F1.4 定焦和紧凑型 F2.8 变焦。没有直接套用全画幅镜身，体积控制得不错，锐度表现稳定。

shortDescription.en: Compact APS-C glass with strong sharpness
shortDescription.zh: 小体积与高锐度兼顾的 APS-C 系列

title.zh: 唯卓仕 Air 系列镜头

description.en: Compact autofocus primes sitting around 170 grams while keeping an F1.7 aperture. Easy to carry all day for street, travel, or casual video when you want light weight without switching to manual focus.
description.zh: 单支多在 170 克左右、同时保留 F1.7 光圈和原生自动对焦的轻便定焦。适合街拍、旅行或随手拍视频，既想轻装又不想退回手动头时很实用。

shortDescription.en: F1.7 autofocus primes around 170 grams
shortDescription.zh: 170 克级的原生自动对焦定焦

title.zh: 唯卓仕 Pro 系列镜头

description.en: Viltrox's flagship autofocus line, built around an F1.2 aperture with metal barrels, weather sealing, and USB-C firmware updates. Competes directly with Fujifilm's top primes at a lower price.
description.zh: 唯卓仕自动对焦产品线里的旗舰系列，以 F1.2 大光圈、金属镜身、防滴防尘和 USB-C 固件升级为特点，在规格上直接对标原厂高阶定焦，价格更低。

shortDescription.en: F1.2 flagships competing with first-party primes
shortDescription.zh: F1.2 旗舰定焦，对标原厂高阶型号

title.zh: 福伦达 Nokton 系列镜头

description.en: Voigtländer's fast manual-focus primes, spanning F1.2 to F0.9. All-metal helicoids with smooth focus damping and classic wide-open rendering rather than clinical modern sharpness — built for shooters who enjoy focusing by hand.
description.zh: 福伦达旗下的大光圈手动定焦系列，光圈从 F1.2 到 F0.9。全金属对焦螺旋手感细腻，全开光圈带有柔和的过渡和古典成像味道，适合偏爱手动对焦节奏的用户。

shortDescription.en: Fast manual primes with classic rendering
shortDescription.zh: 大光圈手动定焦经典系列

title.zh: 思锐 Sniper 系列镜头

description.en: Sirui's F1.2 autofocus primes, priced well below most other F1.2 autofocus lenses on X-mount. Many aperture blades keep out-of-focus highlights round as you stop down; they skip the aperture ring and weather sealing to keep the cost in the glass.
description.zh: 思锐的 F1.2 自动对焦定焦，价格明显低于 X 卡口上大多数 F1.2 自动头。光圈叶片多，收小光圈后焦外光斑依然圆润；省去了光圈环和防滴防尘，把预算集中在大光圈上。

shortDescription.en: Affordable F1.2 autofocus primes
shortDescription.zh: 平价的 F1.2 自动对焦定焦

description.en: 23mm on APS-C matches a 35mm full-frame field of view — wide enough for street context and travel scenes, tight enough for half-body portraits without strong distortion. Covers first-party XF primes alongside third-party autofocus and manual options.
description.zh: 23mm 在 APS-C 上等效全画幅 35mm，兼顾环境交代与主体突出，扫街、纪实和日常记录都很顺手。这里收录了 X 卡口原厂及各家副厂的全部 23mm 定焦。

shortDescription.en: 35mm equiv. — street, travel, and environmental portraits
shortDescription.zh: 等效 35mm，扫街、纪实与旅拍常用焦段

description.en: Equivalent to 50mm on full frame, 35mm gives a natural perspective with minimal distortion. It is the most crowded focal length on X-mount, ranging from inexpensive manual lenses to fast weather-sealed autofocus primes.
description.zh: 在 APS-C 上等效 50mm，视角接近人眼平时注意局部时的透视，变形小、泛用性强。这也是 X 卡口选择最多的焦段，从百元级手动头到现代 F1.4 自动头都有。

shortDescription.en: 50mm equiv. — the standard everyday focal length
shortDescription.zh: 等效 50mm，泛用性最强的标准焦段

description.en: Sitting between a standard prime and an 85mm portrait lens, 50mm on APS-C gives roughly a 75mm equivalent view. Useful for tighter street framing, still life, and half-body portraits where you want moderate compression without stepping far back.
description.zh: 50mm 在 APS-C 上等效约 75mm，介于标头和传统人像焦段之间。空间压缩感适中，适合扫街特写、静物和带环境感的半身人像，不需要退太远就能拍。

shortDescription.en: 75mm equiv. — tight street frames and half-body portraits
shortDescription.zh: 等效 75mm，特写与紧凑人像

description.en: Roughly an 85mm full-frame equivalent — the classic portrait focal length on X-mount. Long enough to flatter facial proportions and blur busy backgrounds cleanly, while keeping a comfortable working distance from your subject.
description.zh: 等效全画幅约 85mm，是 X 卡口最典型的人像定焦焦段。既能避免近距离拍摄的透视变形，又能在合适的工作距离下做出干净的背景虚化。

shortDescription.en: 85mm equiv. — the classic portrait focal length
shortDescription.zh: 等效 85mm，经典人像焦段

description.en: On APS-C, 85mm reaches a 128mm equivalent field of view. Tighter than 56mm, it isolates subjects from cluttered backgrounds and works well for headshots and compressed street details.
description.zh: 在 APS-C 上等效约 128mm，比 56mm 更窄，背景剥离更彻底。虽然在半画幅上相对小众，但拍特写人像、舞台或街头远景压缩很有用。

shortDescription.en: 128mm equiv. — tight isolation and telephoto compression
shortDescription.zh: 等效 128mm，强背景剥离与特写

description.en: X-mount primes at 18mm or wider. Built for landscapes, architecture, interiors, and night skies — from fast astro workhorses to compact street wide-angles and ultra-wide rectilinear glass.
description.zh: 18mm 及更广的 X 卡口定焦镜头。拍风光、星空、建筑或室内需要更大视角时从这里选，涵盖高速夜拍大光圈广角、紧凑扫街头和超广角定焦。

shortDescription.en: 18mm and wider for landscapes, interiors, and astro
shortDescription.zh: 18mm 及更广，风光、室内与星空

description.en: Zoom lenses starting at 12mm or wider on APS-C. Helpful when shooting architecture, tight interiors, or landscapes where you cannot step back and need quick framing adjustments without swapping primes.
description.zh: 广角端达到 12mm 及以下的 X 卡口变焦镜头。拍建筑、室内空间或大风光时往往退无可退，广角变焦能省去频繁换定焦的麻烦。

shortDescription.en: 12mm or wider at the wide end for spaces and landscapes
shortDescription.zh: 广角端 12mm 及以下，室内与风光

description.en: Zooms covering the everyday 15–55mm range on APS-C, moving smoothly from wide environmental shots to short-telephoto portraits. The default single-lens setup for daily carry, travel, and work assignments.
description.zh: 覆盖 APS-C 约 15–55mm 常用焦段的标准变焦镜头，从小广角到中焦人像都能兼顾。日常挂机、出门只带一支镜头时最常见的选择。

shortDescription.en: Everyday zooms covering wide to short-telephoto
shortDescription.zh: 日常挂机最常用的标准变焦

description.en: High-ratio zooms bridging wide-angle and telephoto in one barrel. They trade some edge sharpness and aperture speed for reach, making them practical when you do not want to swap lenses on the move.
description.zh: 高变焦比的大范围变焦镜头，把广角和长焦收进同一支镜身里。用一定的光圈和边缘画质妥协换来全程不断档的焦段覆盖，适合不想在旅途中换镜头的情况。

shortDescription.en: Wide-to-telephoto reach in a single lens
shortDescription.zh: 大变焦比，一支覆盖旅途全焦段

description.en: Zooms starting at 50mm or longer on the wide end. Covers light everyday tele-zooms for portraits and travel details through fast F2.8 zooms and long wildlife lenses.
description.zh: 广角端从 50mm 及以上起步的长焦变焦镜头，涵盖轻便日常长焦、恒定 F2.8 专业变焦以及面向野生动物和运动的远摄型号。

shortDescription.en: Starting at 50mm+ for portraits, sports, and wildlife
shortDescription.zh: 50mm 起步的长焦变焦，人像与远摄

description.en: Zooms that keep the same length from one end of the range to the other: the barrel never extends, so balance stays put on a gimbal, nothing pumps air or dust inside as you zoom, and the barrel cannot creep when pointed down. Most are weather-sealed zooms from ultra-wide to telephoto.
description.zh: 变焦时镜身长度不变的变焦镜头：镜筒不伸缩，装在稳定器上重心不跑，变焦时不会把空气和灰尘吸进镜身，朝下拿时也不会自己滑出来。这里多是带防滴防尘的专业变焦，从超广角到长焦都有。

shortDescription.en: Zooms that never change barrel length
shortDescription.zh: 变焦不伸缩，稳定器友好

description.en: X-mount lenses marked with full or partial weather sealing. Useful alongside a weather-sealed body in rain, dust, or cold. Sealing depth varies by brand and model — partial sealing often covers only the mount gasket — so check each manufacturer's rating.
description.zh: 标注了防滴防尘性能的 X 卡口镜头。里面既有关键部位全面密封的型号，也有只在卡口处加了密封圈的部分防护款，两者防护等级差很多。各厂商标准不同，买前建议对照机身防护规格一起看。

shortDescription.en: Full or partial sealing for rain, dust, and cold
shortDescription.zh: 雨雪、多尘户外环境的防护选择

description.en: X-mount lenses with built-in optical stabilization — called OIS by Fujifilm, VC by Tamron, and OS by Sigma. Helps keep handheld shots sharp at slower shutter speeds and smooths handheld video, especially on bodies without IBIS or at longer focal lengths.
description.zh: 内置光学防抖的 X 卡口镜头（富士叫 OIS，腾龙叫 VC，适马叫 OS）。原理都是靠内部浮动镜组抵消手抖，对没有机身防抖的相机，以及长焦端和慢快门手持拍摄帮助很明显。

shortDescription.en: In-lens stabilization for slower shutters and video
shortDescription.zh: 内置光学防抖，慢快门与视频更稳

description.en: Lenses reaching 300mm full-frame equivalent or beyond. Built for wildlife, birding, aviation, and motorsports when you simply cannot get physically closer to the subject.
description.zh: 等效全画幅 300mm 以上的长焦与变焦镜头。拍野生动物、鸟类、航空或赛车等靠近不了的主体时，主要看这一档的焦距覆盖。

shortDescription.en: 300mm+ equiv. for wildlife, birding, and aviation
shortDescription.zh: 等效 300mm 以上的远摄镜头

description.en: Manual lenses built for motion picture work — typically marked in T-stops, fitted with geared focus and iris rings, and matched across a set for follow-focus rigs and matte boxes. Covers Fujifilm's MKX zooms alongside third-party cine primes.
description.zh: 面向视频与电影拍摄的 X 卡口镜头，通常采用 T 值光圈标定、带齿轮的跟焦与光圈环，并尽量统一前口径以便配合遮光斗和跟焦器。收录富士 MKX 变焦及第三方电影定焦。

shortDescription.en: T-stops, geared rings, and matched front diameters
shortDescription.zh: T 值、齿轮环、统一前口径

description.en: Circular and diagonal fisheye lenses with pronounced barrel distortion and deep depth of field. Used for skate and action video, night skies, tight interiors, and shots where straight lines are meant to bend.
description.zh: 包含圆形与对角线鱼眼的 X 卡口超广角镜头。特点是强烈的桶形畸变和极大的景深，常用于滑板极限运动、星空穹顶或刻意追求视角弯曲张力的画面。

shortDescription.en: Circular and diagonal fisheyes with strong distortion
shortDescription.zh: 强烈桶形畸变的极端广角视角

description.en: Manual lenses that tilt or shift the optical axis relative to the sensor. Tilt rotates the plane of focus for selective sharpness or miniature effects; shift keeps vertical lines straight when shooting architecture or products.
description.zh: 能对镜组进行倾斜（Tilt）或平移（Shift）调整的特殊镜头。倾斜可改变焦平面位置，用来控制景深落点或拍微缩效果；平移能在仰拍建筑或产品时直接校正竖线透视畸变。

shortDescription.en: Focal plane tilt and perspective shift control
shortDescription.zh: 控制焦平面倾斜与建筑透视校正

description.en: Lenses designed for close-up work at high magnification ratios — commonly 0.5×, 1×, or higher. Built for insects, flowers, jewelry, food, and small product details where standard lenses cannot focus close enough.
description.zh: 具备近距离对焦与高放大倍率（常见 0.5×、1× 甚至更高）的镜头。拍昆虫、花卉、饰品、美食或小件产品细节时，普通镜头的最近对焦距离往往不够用。

shortDescription.en: Close focus and high magnification for small subjects
shortDescription.zh: 近距离对焦与高放大倍率，拍静物与生态
